turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
Tell me more about that.
I decided to only drink wine at the weekend, it has been five days without any.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. I think so, yes.
Take your time.
I downloaded a meditation app and I do ten minutes before bed, though I often skip it.
Tell me more about that.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. It is not easy to talk about.
What went through your mind then?
I keep thinking about my grandfather who worked in the mines in Yorkshire and never complained about anything.
And how was that for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I think so, yes.
Take your time.
Peterson wrote to me at midnight again and wanted the shipping report by seven.
Take your time.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. It is not easy to talk about.
What went through your mind then?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
